t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green, yellow, orange, and brown gnomes share a basket. Pink, purple, red and blue gnomes share another. The baskets will have different values - test and find what is  the best one. The best one will change throughout the experiment.

vb_textbox.text: The green, yellow, orange and brown gnomes have a red basket. Every other colour has a gold basket. One of these basket colours  will have a higher value than the other basket colour. Therefore:- Repeat "green, yellow, orange, brown" in your head and only pick those when the red baskets yield is high- Repeat "not green, yellow, orange, brown" in your head and only pick not those colours when the gold baskets yield is highYou will generally get a feel for which baskets yield is highest whilst playing the game, but just switch colours when you notice a streak of bad results.
